import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

root = Path('products/services/existing-package-marketplace-checkout')
source = root / 'payhip-help-seller-links.json'
raw = source.read_bytes()
record = json.loads(raw)
rows = record if isinstance(record, list) else record.get('links', [])
if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
    raise SystemExit('Saved index has no readable links array')
pattern = re.compile(r'pricing|transaction fees?|payment processor|stripe|paypal|payout|refund|terms|prohibited', re.I)
selected = {}
for row in rows:
    if not isinstance(row, dict):
        continue
    url = row.get('url') or row.get('href') or ''
    label = row.get('label') or row.get('text') or row.get('title') or ''
    target = urlsplit(url)
    if target.scheme == 'https' and target.hostname in {'payhip.com', 'help.payhip.com'} and pattern.search(label + ' ' + target.path):
        selected[url] = label
output = root / 'director-checkout-terms-links.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps({'scope': 'Saved first-party index links only. Availability and applicability require reading the target documents.', 'input_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'links': [{'url': url, 'label': label} for url, label in sorted(selected.items())]}, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
